sentences.en: The villagers were displaced by the construction of a dam.
sentences.zh: 由于修建大坝，村民们被迫搬迁。

sentences.en: The new library has been under construction since last year.
sentences.zh: 新图书馆从去年开始一直在建设中。

sentences.en: The construction of the building will be started next year.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑将于明年开工建造。

senses.zh: 建造，建设；建筑业 - 建造物，建筑物 - 解释，意思 - 结构，句法关系 形容词: constructional

mnemonic: 词根记忆：con（共同）+struct（建立）+ ion （表动作）→共同建立→建造
